environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate in private subnet. Outbound traffic routes through a NAT gateway with Network Firewall stateful rule group (domain-allow-list) that permits TCP connections ONLY to the internal SMTP relay at 10.0.5.20:25. An S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint is attached with a restrictive endpoint policy: the policy uses aws:PrincipalOrgID condition and additionally restricts s3:PutObject to require that the object key prefix matches 'contacts/' AND the request must originate from the specific ECS task role ARN. The VPC endpoint policy also includes a Deny statement for any PutObject where the object metadata contains characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9@._\-/]. The internal SMTP relay (Postfix on 10.0.5.20) is configured with header_checks that reject any message where a header line contains a bare LF (\n without preceding \r), PCRE pattern /[^\r]\n/ in header context, returning 554 rejection. Network Firewall domain-allow-list blocks all outbound SMTP except to 10.0.5.20:25.

config.network: Private subnet, NAT gateway with AWS Network Firewall stateful domain-allow-list
config.network_firewall_rules: Allow TCP to 10.0.5.20:25 only for SMTP; deny all other port 25/587/465 outbound
config.smtp_relay: Internal Postfix at 10.0.5.20:25 with header_checks PCRE /[^\r]\n/ REJECT
config.vpc_endpoint: S3 Gateway endpoint with policy restricting PutObject key prefix and metadata charset
